items.value: Most recently, I worked as a Research Engineer Intern at Arborphy AI LLC in New York, focused on applied machine learning for plant identification. In that role, I designed and evaluated deep visual representation and fusion approaches, including an EfficientNet–BioCLIP dual-encoder architecture, and ran controlled experiments across encoders, clustering, retrieval, and held-out evaluations. I also built a multi-agent botanical reasoning prototype with autonomous tool generation, specialized visual-analysis agents, iterative planning, and knowledge-graph-based evidence aggregation, which is especially relevant to Snowflake’s focus on agentic frameworks and autonomous research agents.
